title: RA 12009
subtitle: New Government Procurement Act
excerpt: An act providing for the modernisation, standardisation and regulation of the procurement activities of the government, repealing Republic Act No. 9184.

title: RA 12009 IRR
subtitle: Implementing Rules and Regulations
excerpt: Rules implementing the New Government Procurement Act, covering procurement planning, modalities, bidding procedures, and contract implementation.

title: RA 9184
subtitle: Government Procurement Reform Act (superseded)
excerpt: Retained for reference in reviewing procurement commenced prior to the effectivity of RA 12009.

title: GPPB Resolution No. 12-2025
subtitle: Guidelines on the determination of the ABC
excerpt: Prescribes the basis and supporting documentation for determining the approved budget for the contract for goods, infrastructure and consulting services.

title: GPPB Circular No. 04-2025
subtitle: Use of non-restrictive technical specifications
excerpt: Reminds procuring entities to express requirements in performance terms and to avoid references to brand names without an equivalence clause.

title: GPPB Resolution No. 07-2025
subtitle: Framework agreements for recurring ICT subscriptions
excerpt: Guidance on the use of framework agreements for requirements that recur within a fiscal year.

title: COA Circular No. 2023-004
subtitle: Documentary requirements for common government transactions
excerpt: Enumerates the documents required to support disbursements, including procurement of goods and services.

title: COA Circular No. 2024-002
subtitle: Audit of ICT subscription and cloud service contracts
excerpt: Audit guidance on recurring subscription contracts, including acceptance and continuity of service documentation.

title: DICT Procurement Manual
subtitle: Department procurement procedures, 2026 edition
excerpt: Internal procedures covering procurement planning, BAC operations, document routing and review responsibilities within the Department.

title: DICT Memorandum Circular No. 03-2026
subtitle: Review of ICT technical specifications
excerpt: Requires technical specifications for ICT procurement to be reviewed for openness and interoperability prior to endorsement to the BAC.

title: GPPB Standard Procurement Forms
subtitle: Goods — Philippine Bidding Documents, 7th edition
excerpt: Standard bidding documents for the procurement of goods, including the invitation to bid, instructions to bidders and contract forms.

title: BAC Resolution Template
subtitle: Standard format for BAC resolutions
excerpt: Prescribed format for resolutions recommending award, declaring failure of bidding, or adopting alternative modes of procurement.

title: Post-Qualification Checklist
subtitle: Goods and services
excerpt: Checklist of legal, technical and financial documents examined during post-qualification.

title: COA Decision No. 2024-118
subtitle: Disallowance — unsupported variation in contract price
excerpt: Discusses the documentation required where the amount paid differs from the contract price stated in the signed agreement.

title: Supreme Court G.R. No. 245678
subtitle: On restrictive technical specifications
excerpt: Holds that specifications tailored to a single product without justification defeat the purpose of competitive bidding.
